findings.title: Immutable producer-owned FIM scan custody and monotonic issuer claims
changes: Frozen slots-only custody retains canonical tuple/byte evidence separately from the mutable evaluator view.
Claim validation requires exact current scan and producer lifecycle generations.
The producer burns every attempted custody generation and clears both pending handles.
The evaluator receives copied receipt, identity, and baseline values only.
Issuer-owned generation/path claims reject older and duplicate receipt claims and are not returned by the lease façade.

findings.title: Immutable acceptance dispatch and capability-owned Ed25519 signing
changes: Native receipts are signed by a capability-owned ephemeral Ed25519 signer and verified with copied public material.
The ordinary lease façade no longer returns live signing keys or native enrollment/replay-state dictionaries.
Closure-cell replacement cannot become the acceptance dispatch authority.
The trust label is explicitly same-process-simulation-validation.
findings.boundary: CPython interpreter introspection and native memory are not isolation. Stronger proof requires a separately measured/restricted signer, replay ledger, and verifier service with opaque IPC handles.
